nak.rohini.name: Rohini

nak.mrigashira.name: Mrigashira

nak.punarvasu.name: Punarvasu

nak.pushya.name: Pushya

nak.ashlesha.name: Ashlesha

num.karmicDebt.13: The Karmic Debt of 13 points to a past pattern of avoiding hard work or cutting corners. This lifetime asks you to build things through discipline and honest effort — the payoff for consistent labor is unusually large for you, but shortcuts backfire harder than they would for anyone else.
num.karmicDebt.14: The Karmic Debt of 14 is tied to freedom and self-control, often around excess of some kind. You're here to learn balance and moderation after a past pattern of overindulgence — when you find your own healthy limits, you gain a remarkable adaptability that few others have.
num.karmicDebt.16: The Karmic Debt of 16 involves the ego and relationships — a lesson in humility, usually arriving through the sudden collapse of something you built your identity around. It can feel like a fall from grace, but it clears the way for a more honest, more solid sense of self.
num.karmicDebt.19: The Karmic Debt of 19 is about learning to stand on your own after leaning too heavily on others in the past. Independence, self-reliance, and quiet confidence are the lessons here — help may be slow to arrive, teaching you just how capable you already are.
num.karmicLesson.1: Missing 1s point to a karmic lesson in self-reliance and confidence — life will keep nudging you to trust your own judgment instead of waiting for permission.
num.karmicLesson.2: Missing 2s point to a karmic lesson in cooperation and sensitivity — you're here to learn patience, tact, and how to truly work alongside other people.
num.karmicLesson.3: Missing 3s point to a karmic lesson in self-expression — you may need to consciously practice speaking up, creating, or simply being seen.
num.karmicLesson.4: Missing 4s point to a karmic lesson in discipline and follow-through — structure and patient effort don't come naturally and have to be built on purpose.
num.karmicLesson.5: Missing 5s point to a karmic lesson in adaptability — change may feel unusually hard for you, and learning to embrace it is part of this life's work.
num.karmicLesson.6: Missing 6s point to a karmic lesson in responsibility — commitments, family duties, and follow-through may need conscious, repeated practice.
num.karmicLesson.7: Missing 7s point to a karmic lesson in trust and introspection — you may need to consciously build a practice of solitude, faith, or deeper reflection.
num.karmicLesson.8: Missing 8s point to a karmic lesson in handling power and money — you may need to learn, through direct experience, how to manage ambition and material affairs wisely.
num.karmicLesson.9: Missing 9s point to a karmic lesson in compassion and letting go — generosity and releasing attachments may need to be practiced rather than come naturally.
num.challenge.0: A Challenge of 0 is rare and is traditionally read as an open, do-over challenge — you'll face a bit of every number's lesson, with the freedom to choose your own response each time.
num.challenge.1: This challenge asks you to overcome self-doubt and learn to assert yourself without becoming domineering or overly dependent on others.
num.challenge.2: This challenge asks you to overcome oversensitivity and learn to hold your own opinions without being crushed by criticism or conflict.
num.challenge.3: This challenge asks you to overcome scattered energy or self-criticism, learning to focus your talents instead of spreading them too thin.
num.challenge.4: This challenge asks you to overcome resistance to hard work and structure, learning discipline without becoming rigid or overly controlling.
num.challenge.5: This challenge asks you to overcome impulsiveness and restlessness, learning to use freedom responsibly instead of running from commitment.
num.challenge.6: This challenge asks you to overcome perfectionism or excessive self-sacrifice, learning to accept imperfection in yourself and others.
num.challenge.7: This challenge asks you to overcome isolation and overthinking, learning to trust and open up instead of retreating into suspicion.
num.challenge.8: This challenge asks you to overcome an unhealthy relationship with power or money, learning to use ambition with integrity rather than excess.
num.challenge.9: This challenge asks you to overcome difficulty letting go, learning compassion and generosity instead of clinging to what should be released.

angel.000.title: Infinite Potential
angel.000.meaning: In angel-number folklore, 000 is read as a sign of pure potential and new beginnings — a spiritual blank slate, often said to appear when you're between chapters of life.
angel.111.title: New Beginnings
angel.111.meaning: 111 is one of the most widely reported 'seeing repeating numbers' experiences, traditionally interpreted as a sign that your thoughts are manifesting quickly right now — a nudge to focus on what you actually want.
angel.222.title: Balance & Faith
angel.222.meaning: 222 is traditionally read as a message of balance, patience, and trust — folklore holds that it appears when something you've been working toward is quietly falling into place behind the scenes.
angel.333.title: Growth & Encouragement
angel.333.meaning: 333 is popularly associated with encouragement and creative growth, often said to signal support from your environment (some traditions describe this as 'guides' or 'the universe') during a growth phase.
angel.444.title: Protection & Stability
angel.444.meaning: 444 is one of the most commonly cited 'protection' numbers in angel-number folklore — traditionally read as reassurance that you're supported and on solid ground, even if things feel uncertain.
angel.555.title: Change is Coming
angel.555.meaning: 555 is traditionally interpreted as a sign of significant change on the horizon — folklore frames it as encouragement to stay flexible rather than resist what's shifting.
angel.666.title: Realign & Refocus
angel.666.meaning: Despite its ominous pop-culture reputation, in angel-number folklore 666 is usually read gently — as a nudge to rebalance an area of life (often related to material focus) rather than as a warning of harm.
angel.777.title: Alignment & Luck
angel.777.meaning: 777 is widely regarded in numerology folklore as a fortunate, high-vibration number, traditionally associated with being in alignment with your path and reaping the rewards of past effort.
angel.888.title: Abundance
angel.888.meaning: 888 is traditionally read as a sign of abundance and financial flow, its infinity-like shape lending itself to folklore about cycles of giving and receiving coming into balance.
angel.999.title: Completion
angel.999.meaning: 999 is commonly interpreted as a closing-out number — folklore holds that it marks the end of a significant chapter, clearing space for something new to begin.
angel.1111.title: Awakening
angel.1111.meaning: 1111 is perhaps the most talked-about number in this tradition, often described as a moment of spiritual 'awakening' or alignment — many people report noticing it specifically during periods of major personal change.
angel_numbers.disclaimer: This is folklore and spiritual tradition, not scientific fact — treat these meanings as a reflective prompt, not a prediction.
aura.color.red.name: Red Aura
aura.color.red.description: A red aura signifies a deeply grounded, fiery, and passionate personality. You are a natural-born leader, fearless, and deeply connected to your physical reality.
aura.color.red.strength: Unmatched courage, high physical energy, and the ability to manifest ideas into reality quickly.
aura.color.red.balanceTip: When imbalanced, you may feel angry or restless. Spend time in nature and practice grounding meditations to release excess energy.
aura.color.orange.name: Orange Aura
aura.color.orange.description: An orange aura radiates creativity, sensuality, and joy. You are highly sociable, emotionally intelligent, and thrive when you are expressing yourself.
aura.color.orange.strength: Vibrant creativity, strong emotional connections, and an infectious enthusiasm for life.
aura.color.orange.balanceTip: If your energy feels stagnant, engage in a creative hobby or movement like dancing to get your sacral energy flowing again.
aura.color.yellow.name: Yellow Aura
aura.color.yellow.description: A yellow aura shines with intellect, optimism, and strong personal power. You have a radiant, sunny disposition and a powerful sense of self-worth.
aura.color.yellow.strength: Brilliant intellect, unshakeable confidence, and the ability to inspire others with your positive outlook.
aura.color.yellow.balanceTip: A blocked solar plexus can lead to self-doubt. Practice affirmations of self-worth and spend time in direct sunlight to recharge.
aura.color.green.name: Green Aura
aura.color.green.description: A green aura indicates a natural healer. You are deeply compassionate, loving, and intimately connected to nature and the well-being of others.
aura.color.green.strength: Profound empathy, unconditional love, and a calming presence that puts others at ease.
aura.color.green.balanceTip: You tend to give too much of yourself. Ensure you set healthy boundaries and practice radical self-care to avoid emotional burnout.
aura.color.blue.name: Blue Aura
aura.color.blue.description: A blue aura reflects a deeply expressive, calm, and honest soul. You are a natural communicator who values truth, clarity, and peace.
aura.color.blue.strength: Exceptional communication skills, deep inner peace, and the courage to speak your authentic truth.
aura.color.blue.balanceTip: If you feel misunderstood, your throat chakra may be blocked. Try journaling or singing to clear the energy pathway of expression.
aura.color.indigo.name: Indigo Aura
aura.color.indigo.description: An indigo aura is the mark of a highly intuitive, spiritually gifted individual. You see beyond the surface and possess a deep, inner knowing.
aura.color.indigo.strength: Powerful psychic abilities, deep spiritual insight, and a strong connection to your inner guidance.
aura.color.indigo.balanceTip: To avoid feeling overwhelmed by your sensitivities, practice grounding exercises and trust the visions you receive.
aura.color.violet.name: Violet Aura
aura.color.violet.description: A violet aura signifies a highly evolved spiritual seeker. You are deeply connected to the divine, possessing wisdom and a visionary mind.
aura.color.violet.strength: Profound spiritual wisdom, visionary leadership, and a deep sense of universal connection.
aura.color.violet.balanceTip: You may struggle with feeling disconnected from the physical world. Remember to ground yourself in your body through physical exercise.
aura.color.magenta.name: Magenta Aura
aura.color.magenta.description: A magenta aura is rare, combining physical mastery with deep spiritual wisdom. You are a non-conformist, bringing radical new ideas of love and harmony into the world.
aura.color.magenta.strength: Fearless individuality, boundless creative energy, and the ability to manifest on a grand scale.
aura.color.magenta.balanceTip: Your intense energy can sometimes scatter. Focus on one major goal at a time to fully channel your immense manifestation power.
aura.color.gold.name: Gold / White Aura
aura.color.gold.description: A gold or white aura is the signature of an enlightened soul. You are a spiritual teacher, radiating divine protection, purity, and universal wisdom.
aura.color.gold.strength: A pure heart, powerful spiritual protection, and the ability to uplift the consciousness of everyone you meet.
aura.color.gold.balanceTip: Because you operate at such a high frequency, the dense energies of the world can be draining. Protect your energy field with regular spiritual cleansing.

palmistry.handShape.earth.name: Earth Hand
palmistry.handShape.earth.traits: A square, solid palm with short, thick fingers. Traditionally read as practical, grounded, and reliable — someone who trusts what they can see and touch, works steadily, and is uncomfortable with abstraction for its own sake.
palmistry.handShape.air.name: Air Hand
palmistry.handShape.air.traits: A square or rectangular palm with long fingers and often visible knuckles. Traditionally linked to communication, intellect, and restlessness — a quick mind that needs new ideas and conversation the way other hands need routine.
palmistry.handShape.fire.name: Fire Hand
palmistry.handShape.fire.traits: A long or rectangular palm with short fingers, often warm and flushed. Traditionally associated with energy, enthusiasm, and impulsiveness — a hand that reaches for the next thing before finishing the last, and leads with instinct over analysis.
palmistry.handShape.water.name: Water Hand
palmistry.handShape.water.traits: A long, oval palm with long, flexible fingers. Traditionally read as sensitive, imaginative, and emotionally attuned — a hand said to belong to dreamers, artists, and people who absorb the moods of a room without trying to.
palmistry.heartLine.long_curved.title: Long and gently curved
palmistry.heartLine.long_curved.meaning: A long, softly curving Heart Line is traditionally read as warm and expressive in love — someone who feels deeply, shows it openly, and isn't afraid of emotional risk. Hast Rekha Shastra links this to a generous, affectionate Venusian temperament.
palmistry.heartLine.straight_short.title: Short and straight
palmistry.heartLine.straight_short.meani: A short, straight Heart Line is traditionally associated with a more guarded, practical approach to love — affection expressed through action and loyalty rather than grand declarations, and a real dislike of performative romance.
palmistry.heartLine.deeply_etched.title: Deep and clearly etched
palmistry.heartLine.deeply_etched.meanin: A deep, well-defined Heart Line is traditionally read as emotional intensity and constancy — feelings that run strong and steady rather than shallow or fickle, once trust has been given.
palmistry.heartLine.chained.title: Chained or wavy
palmistry.heartLine.chained.meaning: A chained or wavy Heart Line is traditionally interpreted as a history of emotional ups and downs in relationships — sensitivity that can tip into overwhelm, and a need to consciously build emotional steadiness rather than expect it to come easily.
palmistry.heartLine.forked_end.title: Forked at the end
palmistry.heartLine.forked_end.meaning: A Heart Line that forks near the index or middle finger is traditionally read as balance — the ability to love both passionately and sensibly, holding both the heart's wants and the head's judgment at once.
palmistry.heartLine.broken.title: Broken or interrupted
palmistry.heartLine.broken.meaning: A break in the Heart Line is traditionally read as a significant emotional turning point — often a past heartbreak or a relationship that reshaped how you love, rather than a permanent flaw.
palmistry.headLine.long_straight.title: Long and straight
palmistry.headLine.long_straight.meaning: A long, straight Head Line is traditionally read as focused, logical, and realistic thinking — a mind that likes clear evidence and dislikes ambiguity, well-suited to detailed or technical work.
palmistry.headLine.sloping.title: Sloping toward the wrist
palmistry.headLine.sloping.meaning: A Head Line that curves down toward the wrist (toward the Mount of the Moon) is traditionally associated with imagination and creativity — a mind that thinks in pictures and possibilities rather than strictly in facts.
palmistry.headLine.short.title: Short and direct
palmistry.headLine.short.meaning: A short Head Line is traditionally read as decisive, single-minded thinking — someone who prefers to act quickly on a conclusion rather than turning a problem over for a long time.
palmistry.headLine.forked_writers.title: Forked at the end (the \"writer's fork\")
palmistry.headLine.forked_writers.meanin: A Head Line that splits into two branches near its end is traditionally called the writer's fork, read as the ability to hold both practical and imaginative thinking at once — often associated with skill in writing or persuasive communication.
palmistry.headLine.chained.title: Chained or faint
palmistry.headLine.chained.meaning: A chained or faint Head Line is traditionally read as a mind prone to distraction or overthinking — sharp in bursts, but needing structure to stay focused on one thread at a time.
palmistry.headLine.deeply_etched.title: Deep and unbroken
palmistry.headLine.deeply_etched.meaning: A deep, unbroken Head Line is traditionally read as strong mental discipline and clarity — steady concentration and a memory that holds onto detail well.
palmistry.lifeLine.wide_curve.title: Wide, sweeping curve
palmistry.lifeLine.wide_curve.meaning: A Life Line that arcs well out into the palm is traditionally read as strong vitality and an enthusiastic, energetic approach to life — comfortable taking up space and pursuing what you want.
palmistry.lifeLine.close_curve.title: Close to the thumb
palmistry.lifeLine.close_curve.meaning: A Life Line that hugs close to the thumb is traditionally associated with a more cautious, careful temperament — energy conserved rather than spent freely, and a preference for the familiar over the unknown.
palmistry.lifeLine.deeply_etched.title: Deep and clearly etched
palmistry.lifeLine.deeply_etched.meaning: A deep, well-defined Life Line is traditionally read as robust physical vitality and resilience — the capacity to recover well from setbacks.
palmistry.lifeLine.doubled.title: Doubled (a second line running alongside)
palmistry.lifeLine.doubled.meaning: A faint second line running alongside the Life Line is traditionally called a 'sister line' and is read as extra support and protection through hard periods — traditionally a favorable sign in both Western and Hast Rekha Shastra readings.
palmistry.lifeLine.broken.title: Broken or interrupted
palmistry.lifeLine.broken.meaning: A break in the Life Line is traditionally read as a major life change or turning point — a shift in circumstances or direction, not (in any serious reading of the tradition) a literal marker of illness or lifespan.
palmistry.lifeLine.chained.title: Chained near the start
palmistry.lifeLine.chained.meaning: Chaining in the Life Line near the thumb is traditionally associated with a more sensitive constitution in early life, often said to settle into steadier vitality as the line clears further along its curve.
palmistry.fateLine.absent_faint.title: Absent or very faint
palmistry.fateLine.absent_faint.meaning: No clear Fate Line is traditionally read as a life built more by your own choices than by circumstance or a fixed path — freedom, but also more responsibility for charting your own direction.
palmistry.fateLine.straight_deep.title: Straight and deeply etched
palmistry.fateLine.straight_deep.meaning: A strong, straight Fate Line running from the base of the palm toward the fingers is traditionally read as a clear, purposeful sense of direction in career and life path, often set early and pursued with consistency.
palmistry.fateLine.starts_late.title: Starts partway up the palm
palmistry.fateLine.starts_late.meaning: A Fate Line that only begins partway up the palm is traditionally read as a life direction that becomes clear later — often after a formative period of searching or a distinct turning point.
palmistry.fateLine.wavy_broken.title: Wavy or broken
palmistry.fateLine.wavy_broken.meaning: A wavy or broken Fate Line is traditionally associated with a career or life path that changes direction more than once — traditionally read as adaptability rather than instability.
palmistry.sunLine.absent.title: Absent or very faint
palmistry.sunLine.absent.meaning: No strong Sun Line is traditionally read as fulfillment found more through quiet, personal satisfaction than through public recognition — success measured on your own terms.
palmistry.sunLine.clear_present.title: Clear and present
palmistry.sunLine.clear_present.meaning: A clear Sun (Apollo) Line beneath the ring finger is traditionally read as a gift for creative or public success — recognition, charisma, and a life where your work tends to be noticed.
palmistry.sunLine.faint_multiple.title: Several faint lines
palmistry.sunLine.faint_multiple.meaning: Multiple faint Sun Lines are traditionally read as talent spread across several creative pursuits rather than concentrated in one — versatility, though sometimes at the cost of specializing deeply in a single one.
palmistry.marriageLine.one_deep.title: One deep, clear line
palmistry.marriageLine.one_deep.meaning: A single deep line here is traditionally read as one especially significant, lasting emotional partnership — depth and commitment rather than frequency.
palmistry.marriageLine.two_lines.title: Two lines of similar depth
palmistry.marriageLine.two_lines.meaning: Two lines of similar strength are traditionally read as two major emotional partnerships across a lifetime, both significant rather than one being a 'lesser' relationship.
palmistry.marriageLine.faint_multiple.me: Several faint lines are traditionally read as an emotionally rich romantic history — meaningful connections and attachments, without any one reading as more 'permanent' than the others.

palmistry.history.india_vedic.title: Vedic India — Hast Rekha Shastra
palmistry.history.india_vedic.text: Palmistry's oldest surviving textual roots are usually traced to India, where Hast Rekha Shastra (\"the science of hand lines\") developed as part of the broader Vedic sciences alongside Jyotisha (Vedic astrology). Tradition credits the sage Valmiki with an early Sanskrit treatise on the subject. This is also the tradition that mapped the palm's mounts to the same nine grahas (planets) used in Vedic birth-chart astrology — the same graha system this app's Kundli feature uses — which is why palmistry and astrology have always been closely linked in Indian practice.
palmistry.history.china.title: Ancient China — 掌相 (Zhang Xiang)
palmistry.history.china.text: Chinese palmistry developed independently, as part of a wider system of physiognomy (面相, reading the face and body) rooted in Taoist and folk-cosmological ideas about qi and the five elements. It names the palm's three principal lines the Heaven line, Human line, and Earth line, and reads the hand's overall shape and texture as an expression of a person's elemental balance, distinct from — but conceptually parallel to — the Western and Indian line systems.
palmistry.history.greece.title: Ancient Greece — chiromancy enters the West
palmistry.history.greece.text: In the Greek world, palmistry (then called chiromancy) was taken seriously enough that Aristotle is traditionally said to have written on the subject, and it's mentioned by later classical writers as an established, if debated, practice. Through Greek and later Arabic scholarship, this is the route by which hand-reading entered the Western intellectual tradition alongside astrology and medicine.
palmistry.history.medieval_arabic.title: The Islamic Golden Age — preserved and expanded
palmistry.history.medieval_arabic.text: During the Islamic Golden Age, Arabic scholars translated, preserved, and expanded on Greek texts covering chiromancy alongside astrology and medicine, at a time when much of this material was being lost in Europe. Their work is a major reason classical hand-reading texts survived to reach medieval Europe at all.
palmistry.history.medieval_europe.title: Medieval and Renaissance Europe
palmistry.history.medieval_europe.text: Chiromancy re-entered Europe through Latin translations of Arabic texts and became a common (if often condemned by the Church) folk and court practice through the medieval and Renaissance periods. Romani travelers, arriving in Europe from the 15th century onward, became closely associated with palmistry in the popular imagination — a link that persists in Western pop culture today, though the practice by then already had many independent European roots of its own.
palmistry.history.modern_western.title: Modern Western chirology
palmistry.history.modern_western.text: The line-and-mount system most familiar in the West today — Heart, Head, Life, Fate, and Sun lines; the seven planetary mounts; the four elemental hand shapes (Earth, Air, Fire, Water) — was systematized in the late 19th and early 20th century by writers such as William G. Benham (\"The Laws of Scientific Hand Reading\", 1900) and the popular fortune-teller Cheiro (Count Louis Hamon). This is the version of palmistry most Western books and apps, including this one, actually draw on.
palmistry.history.title: A Brief History of Palm Reading
palmistry.history.intro: Palmistry isn't one tradition — it developed independently in several cultures over thousands of years before converging into the system used today.

horoscope.blurb.aries: Bold, competitive, and first out of the gate — Aries leads with instinct and raw energy.
horoscope.about.aries: Aries is the pioneer of the zodiac! You are brave, direct, and love a good challenge. You follow your gut and dive headfirst into life without overthinking.
horoscope.blurb.taurus: Steady, sensual, and stubborn in the best way — Taurus builds comfort and beauty that lasts.
horoscope.about.taurus: Taurus is the anchor of the zodiac! You are patient, love luxury, and hate being rushed. You prefer comfort and loyalty over constant changes.
horoscope.blurb.gemini: Curious, quick-witted, and endlessly social — Gemini thrives on ideas and conversation.
horoscope.about.gemini: Gemini is the social butterfly of the zodiac! You are curious, funny, and incredibly adaptable. You love picking up new ideas and chatting with everyone.
horoscope.blurb.cancer: Deeply emotional and fiercely protective — Cancer feels everything and remembers everyone.
horoscope.about.cancer: Cancer is the heart of the zodiac! You are deeply caring, protective, and emotional. You always prioritize your home and the people you love.
horoscope.blurb.leo: Warm, dramatic, and magnetic — Leo was born to be seen and to make others feel special too.
horoscope.about.leo: Leo is the star of the zodiac! You are warm, generous, and a natural leader. You love being in the spotlight and making others feel special too.
horoscope.blurb.virgo: Precise, thoughtful, and quietly perfectionist — Virgo notices what everyone else misses.
horoscope.about.virgo: Virgo is the perfectionist of the zodiac! You are organized, practical, and have an amazing eye for detail. You love helping others fix their problems.
horoscope.blurb.libra: Charming and fair-minded — Libra seeks balance, beauty, and connection in everything.
horoscope.about.libra: Libra is the diplomat of the zodiac! You seek balance, beauty, and peace in everything. You are charming and love creating harmony in your relationships.
horoscope.blurb.scorpio: Intense, magnetic, and impossible to fool — Scorpio sees straight through the surface.
horoscope.about.scorpio: Scorpio is the most intense sign of the zodiac! You are deeply loyal, magnetic, and can see right through lies. You feel everything with extreme passion.
horoscope.blurb.sagittarius: Adventurous and blunt in the most refreshing way — Sagittarius is always chasing the next horizon.
horoscope.about.sagittarius: Sagittarius is the adventurer of the zodiac! You are optimistic, blunt, and always chasing the next horizon. You need freedom and love exploring the world.
horoscope.blurb.capricorn: Disciplined and ambitious — Capricorn plays the long game and almost always wins it.
horoscope.about.capricorn: Capricorn is the boss of the zodiac! You are disciplined, ambitious, and play the long game. You work hard and almost always achieve your goals.
horoscope.blurb.aquarius: Independent and visionary — Aquarius would rather be right than be liked.
horoscope.about.aquarius: Aquarius is the innovator of the zodiac! You are incredibly independent, original, and a bit rebellious. You care deeply about making the world a better place.
horoscope.blurb.pisces: Dreamy, empathetic, and artistic — Pisces feels the world in colors most people can't see.
horoscope.about.pisces: Pisces is the dreamer of the zodiac! You are highly imaginative, empathetic, and artistic. You easily absorb the emotions of everyone around you.

palmistry.career.steady_climb.title: A steady, self-built climb
palmistry.career.steady_climb.meaning: Traditionally read as a career built through consistent effort rather than a single lucky break — progress that compounds quietly year over year. Recognition tends to arrive a little after the work that earned it, not before.
palmistry.career.late_bloomer.title: Direction that clarifies later
palmistry.career.late_bloomer.meaning: Traditionally read as a path that takes longer to settle into focus, often after an earlier phase of searching or trying different things. Once it clicks, it tends to be pursued with real conviction.
palmistry.career.reinvention.title: More than one chapter
palmistry.career.reinvention.meaning: Traditionally read as a career that changes direction at least once, not from instability but from genuine range — skills from an earlier chapter often resurface usefully in a later one. Adaptability is the throughline, not any single job title.
palmistry.career.leadership.title: A pull toward leading
palmistry.career.leadership.meaning: Traditionally read as a natural draw toward responsibility and being the one others look to for direction. This tends to show up early, even in informal settings, well before any official title catches up to it.
palmistry.career.craft_focused.title: Depth over breadth
palmistry.career.craft_focused.meaning: Traditionally read as fulfillment found in going deep on a single craft or specialty rather than spreading across many roles. Mastery, in this reading, matters more than visibility.
palmistry.growth.through_challenge.title: Growth through what tests you
palmistry.growth.through_challenge.meani: Traditionally read as a person who develops most in periods of real difficulty rather than comfort — the hard chapters tend to be the ones that reshape you the most. Ease is welcome, but rarely where the biggest change happens.
palmistry.growth.steady_maturing.title: Quiet, steady maturing
palmistry.growth.steady_maturing.meaning: Traditionally read as gradual, consistent inner development rather than sudden transformation — the kind of growth that's hard to notice week to week but is unmistakable looking back a few years.
palmistry.growth.turning_point.title: A defining turning point
palmistry.growth.turning_point.meaning: Traditionally read as a life shaped around one or two pivotal moments that genuinely changed its direction, rather than many small shifts. You likely already know, or will recognize, when it happens.
palmistry.growth.self_taught.title: Growth through self-direction
palmistry.growth.self_taught.meaning: Traditionally read as someone who grows more through their own initiative — reading, reflecting, trying things alone — than through formal guidance. Self-trust is both the challenge and the reward here.
palmistry.growth.through_others.title: Growth through relationships
palmistry.growth.through_others.meaning: Traditionally read as a person shaped significantly by the people closest to them — mentors, partners, close friends — more than by solitary experience. Who you spend time with matters more than usual for how you develop.
palmistry.money.builder.title: Wealth built, not inherited
palmistry.money.builder.meaning: Traditionally read as financial security earned gradually through effort and patience rather than windfalls — steady accumulation over any single big win. Discipline with money tends to matter more than income itself.
palmistry.money.cautious.title: Careful, protective instincts
palmistry.money.cautious.meaning: Traditionally read as a cautious, security-minded relationship with money — a preference for saving and stability over risk. This reading favors preparation over chasing opportunity.
palmistry.money.feast_famine.title: Uneven, but resilient
palmistry.money.feast_famine.meaning: Traditionally read as financial fortunes that move in cycles rather than a flat, predictable line — genuine highs and real tight periods both. Resilience through the lean stretches is the actual skill this placement points to.
palmistry.money.generous.title: Open-handed with resources
palmistry.money.generous.meaning: Traditionally read as someone who holds money loosely — generous with others, sometimes to their own detriment. Learning when to hold on is the growth edge this reading suggests.
palmistry.money.entrepreneurial.title: Independent income instincts
palmistry.money.entrepreneurial.meaning: Traditionally read as a pull toward earning on your own terms — business, freelance work, or ventures outside a conventional single employer. Traditionally linked to the Mount of Mercury's business instincts.

palmistry.marriageSummary.early_strong.m: Traditionally read as someone who recognizes serious partnership early and commits with real conviction once they do. Second-guessing tends not to be the pattern here.

palmistry.result.specific_predictions_no: Highly specific outcomes derived from traditional line combinations.
palmistry.specific.marriage.foreigner.me: You are likely to marry or build a deep connection with someone from a different country or culture!
palmistry.specific.marriage.childhood.me: You are meant to marry someone you have known since childhood or who feels like home to you.
palmistry.specific.marriage.sudden.title: Sudden Commitment
palmistry.specific.marriage.sudden.meani: Your lines show a sudden, surprising, but amazing marriage or commitment in your life!
palmistry.specific.marriage.steady.title: Gradual Alignment
palmistry.specific.marriage.steady.meani: Your relationships are built on strong friendship and trust that grows slowly over time.
palmistry.specific.children.two_phases.m: You will likely have two distinct phases in your life where your family grows or you focus on raising children.
palmistry.specific.children.large_family: Your hand shows a ton of warm, loving energy, pointing to a large and happy family life!
palmistry.specific.children.focused.mean: You will pour all your love and attention into raising one or two very special children.
You are destined to buy your own home or property at a surprisingly young age!
Your lines suggest you will be lucky enough to own multiple homes or travel between different houses.
palmistry.specific.house.later_settlemen: You will move around a bit when younger, but eventually settle into your absolute dream home.
palmistry.minorLine.health.clear.title: Health Line: Clear
palmistry.minorLine.health.clear.meaning: You have a strong stomach and great natural health. You bounce back easily from stress!
palmistry.minorLine.health.absent.title: Health Line: Absent
palmistry.minorLine.health.absent.meanin: You are naturally tough and rarely get sick. Not having this line is actually a great sign of health!
palmistry.minorLine.intuition.crescent.m: You have a powerful 'sixth sense' and very vivid dreams. Always trust your gut feelings!
palmistry.minorLine.intuition.faint.mean: You have good instincts, but you prefer to think things through logically rather than just guessing.
palmistry.minorLine.travel.strong.title: Travel Lines: Strong
palmistry.minorLine.travel.strong.meanin: You have a strong urge to travel! You will likely spend a lot of time living or traveling abroad.
palmistry.minorLine.travel.local.title: Travel Lines: Faint
palmistry.minorLine.travel.local.meaning: You love the comfort of your home and community. You will find your greatest happiness staying close to your roots.
palmistry.minorLine.girdle.present.title: Girdle of Venus: Present
palmistry.minorLine.girdle.present.meani: You are a deeply passionate, creative, and romantic person who feels emotions very strongly.
palmistry.minorLine.girdle.absent.title: Girdle of Venus: Absent
palmistry.minorLine.girdle.absent.meanin: You are very calm and level-headed. You don't let your emotions easily control your actions.
palmistry.chirognomy.shape.pointed.title: Pointed Fingers
palmistry.chirognomy.shape.pointed.meani: Your fingers are pointed, meaning you are a dreamer! You rely on inspiration and have an artistic soul.
palmistry.chirognomy.shape.conic.title: Conic Fingers
palmistry.chirognomy.shape.conic.meaning: Your fingers are cone-shaped, showing you are a quick thinker, very creative, and easily charm others.
palmistry.chirognomy.shape.square.title: Square Fingers
palmistry.chirognomy.shape.square.meanin: Your square fingers show you are practical, organized, and love order. You get things done!
palmistry.chirognomy.shape.spatulate.mea: Your flat, flared fingers show you have endless energy! You love being active and trying new things.
palmistry.chirognomy.thumb.willpower.mea: The top of your thumb is strong, showing you have immense willpower. You never give up on your goals!
palmistry.chirognomy.thumb.logic.title: Thumb: Strong Logic
palmistry.chirognomy.thumb.logic.meaning: The bottom of your thumb is long, meaning you are very logical. You think carefully before taking any action.
palmistry.chirognomy.thumb.flexible.mean: Your thumb bends back easily, showing you are flexible, easy-going, and love going with the flow.
palmistry.chirognomy.thumb.stiff.title: Thumb: Stiff
palmistry.chirognomy.thumb.stiff.meaning: Your thumb is stiff, which means you are stubborn in a good way—you stand your ground and people can rely on you.
palmistry.mysticMark.mystic_cross.title: The Mystic Cross
palmistry.mysticMark.mystic_cross.meanin: You have the Mystic Cross! You have a natural gift for understanding psychology, spirituality, and reading people's minds.
palmistry.mysticMark.ring_of_solomon.mea: You have the Ring of Solomon! This rare mark means you have deep wisdom and are a natural teacher or leader.
palmistry.mysticMark.star_apollo.title: Star of Apollo
palmistry.mysticMark.star_apollo.meaning: You have the Star of Apollo! This amazing mark brings sudden fame, extreme luck, and great success in your career.
palmistry.mysticMark.triangle_life.title: Triangle on Life Line
palmistry.mysticMark.triangle_life.meani: There's a triangle on your life line! This points to a massive financial gain or a huge achievement in your life.
palmistry.mysticMark.healers_mark.title: The Healer's Mark
palmistry.mysticMark.healers_mark.meanin: You have the Healer's Mark! You bring peace and comfort to others, and animals or friends naturally flock to you when they are sad.
palmistry.result.biometrics_note: Simulated mathematical analysis of hand geometry.
palmistry.biometric.phi.high.title: High Golden Ratio
palmistry.biometric.phi.high.meaning: Your hand is perfectly proportioned! This means you naturally love beauty and want your life to be peaceful and balanced.
palmistry.biometric.phi.moderate.title: Practical Proportions
palmistry.biometric.phi.moderate.meaning: Your hand favors practical sizing. You care more about things actually working than just looking pretty!
palmistry.biometric.digit_ratio.ring_lon: Your ring finger is long! You are a natural risk-taker, love a challenge, and are driven to make money.
palmistry.biometric.digit_ratio.index_lo: Your index finger is long! You are a born boss. You love taking charge and leading the group.
palmistry.biometric.digit_ratio.equal.me: Your index and ring fingers are equal! You perfectly balance being ambitious while still being a great friend.
palmistry.biometric.thumb_angle.wide.mea: Your thumb sits wide from your hand. You are fiercely independent and hate being told what to do!
palmistry.biometric.thumb_angle.narrow.m: Your thumb stays close to your hand. You are careful, protective, and like to play it safe.
palmistry.biometric.triangle_angle.acute: Your lines form a tight 'Money Triangle'. This means you are fantastic at saving money and keeping your wealth!
palmistry.biometric.triangle_angle.obtus: Your 'Money Triangle' is wide open. You love spending money on fun experiences rather than just hoarding it in a bank!

privacy.s1.p1: Cosmic Numbers has no backend, no user accounts, and no database. The name and date of birth you type in are used only to calculate your numerology, horoscope, or compatibility results directly in your own browser — that data is never sent to us or stored on any server we control.
privacy.s2.title: What information we process
privacy.s2.p1: When you use a calculator (Numerology, Horoscope, Compatibility, or Nakshatra), the name and date of birth you enter are processed entirely client-side, in JavaScript running on your device, to compute your result. We do not transmit this information to a server, and we do not collect, log, or store it anywhere.
privacy.s2.p2: If you use a "Share" link for a result, that information (e.g. your name and life path number) is encoded directly into the URL as query parameters so the page can regenerate the same result for whoever opens the link. It is not saved in a database — it exists only in that URL.
privacy.s3.title: Local storage & gamification
privacy.s3.p1: To power streaks, XP, and badges, Cosmic Numbers stores small pieces of data (such as your current streak count and which badges you've unlocked) in your browser's local storage. This data stays on your device, is never transmitted to us, and can be cleared at any time by clearing your browser's site data for this domain.
privacy.s4.title: Hosting & server logs
privacy.s4.p1: This site is hosted on Vercel. Like virtually any web host, Vercel's infrastructure may automatically record standard technical request logs (such as IP address, browser type, and request timestamps) for security, performance, and abuse-prevention purposes. We do not access these logs to identify individuals, and they are not linked to the numerology or horoscope data you enter.
privacy.s5.title: Advertising & Google AdSense
privacy.s5.p1: Cosmic Numbers may display advertisements served by Google AdSense to support the free tools on this site. If ads are enabled, Google and its partners may use cookies, device identifiers, and similar technologies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites, and to measure ad performance.
privacy.s5.p2: You can learn more about how Google uses data when you use its partners' sites or apps, and opt out of personalized advertising, at
privacy.s5.p3: . You can also manage your ad personalization settings directly at
privacy.s5.p4: . Cosmic Numbers itself does not control how Google's ad systems process your data — that is governed by Google's own privacy policy.
privacy.s6.title: Children's privacy
privacy.s6.p1: This site is intended for a general audience and does not knowingly collect personal information from children. Since no personal data is stored on our servers to begin with, there is no account or profile data to request the deletion of.
privacy.s7.title: Changes to this policy
privacy.s7.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, for example if we enable new features or advertising services. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated "last updated" date.

terms.s1.p2: You should not make important life decisions — financial, medical, relationship, or otherwise — based solely on content from this site.

We do not guarantee the site will be uninterrupted, error-free, or available at all times.
